## !! DELEGATION CONSTRAINTS
**Currently allowed worker models (picker ids): `luna` (medium/high), `terra` (low/medium/high), `haiku` (medium), `haiku-api` (medium), `onyx`, `opus` (low/medium), `sonnet` (low/medium/high), `sol` (low/medium), `deepseek` (default), `composer`, `deepseek-or` (high), `haiku-work` (medium), `haiku-neozeit` (medium), `grok-low`, `grok-medium`, `grok-47-medium` (default), `terra-api` (low/medium), `luna-api` (low/medium/high), `composer-fast`, `gpt62-sol` (low).**
Anything else is off limits for delegation (except the escalation tier in DELEGATION.md), even if `quota pick` names it or an old note says it is fine.
A candidate with under 5% headroom in any usage window is also refused: pick the next option, don't argue with the number.
Down until reset: none. Source of truth: `~/.agents/picker/guards.json` (`allowedModels`); `quota pick` enforces it.
If David says usage is running low, or a window is burning faster than planned: stop, re-run `quota status` and `quota pick`, re-evaluate the task against the allowed list, and propose the cheapest adequate option before launching anything.
<!-- DELEGATION-CONSTRAINTS:END -->

## Stack and layout
- Python 3.12+ with uv (`pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`). Standard library only; pytest and ruff are dev dependencies.
- `ladder.py`: the ladder runner. `models.example.json`: example model config, selected with `LADDER_MODELS_FILE`.
- `tasks/`: task fixtures (`input/`, `solution/`, `overlay/`, `mcp/`) and `jobs.json`.
- `tests/`: pytest suites for the example, MCP and ladder code.

## Commands
- Tests: `uv run python -m pytest -q` (no network or real model launches).
- Lint: `uv run ruff check .`
- Next attempt: `uv run python ladder.py next build`
- Dry run: `LADDER_MODELS_FILE=$PWD/models.example.json uv run python ladder.py run --dry-run <task> <model> <effort>`
